name: Wonder Wallet
description: A self-custodial Bitcoin wallet for collectors. Your keys, your assets, and your data stay on your own device.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://stampchain.io; connect-src 'self' https://mempool.space https://api.counterparty.io:4000 https://stampchain.io https://ordinals.com https://eth.drpc.org https://base.drpc.org https://arbitrum.drpc.org https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com https://api.coingecko.com https://v2.emblemvault.io https://v3.emblemvault.io; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

_wonder_wallet_notes.purpose: Canonical, most-secure shell (SPEC §3). Fully local — no proxy server.
_wonder_wallet_notes.phase: Phase 11 — packaging. Calls data sources directly via host_permissions; all state in chrome.storage / IndexedDB.
_wonder_wallet_notes.data_layer: popup loads a fetch-shim that maps the web app's `api/...` calls to direct source fetches (porting server.js routes client-side), so the 13 UI modules + wallet-core run unchanged.
_wonder_wallet_notes.distribution: Packaged .zip -> Chrome Web Store / unpacked load. NOT served by Emblem:build (which hosts the web preview).
